body.p: Favorable reconsideration of this application is respectfully requested.
Claims 1-13 are pending in the present application. Claim 1 is amended, and Claim 7 is canceled by the present amendment. No new matter is presented.

In the Office Action, Claims 1-5, 8, 10-11, and 13 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 102(a)(1) as being anticipated by Pollack et al (US 20190299415), Claim 6 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over Pollack et al in view of Hashimoto et al (US 20090093908), Claim 7 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over Pollack et al in view of Takeuchi et al (US20 190232493), and Claims 9 and 12 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over Pollack et al in view of Cordell et al (US 6996456), and the subject matter of Claim 7 is allowable.
Claim 7 has been indicated as containing allowable subject matter. Claim 1 is amended to include the subject matter of Claim 7, and Claim 7 is canceled. Accordingly, Claim 1 is patentable.
The dependent claims are patentable at least for the reasons Claim 1 is patentable.

The present amendment is submitted in accordance with the provisions of 37 CFR 1.116 in that Claim 1 is amended to include subject matter indicated as being allowable, and Claim 7 is canceled. Accordingly, entry of the amendment is respectfully requested.
Consequently, in light of the above discussion, this application is believed to be in
condition for allowance, and an early and favorable action to that effect is respectfully requested.
Reply to Office Action of December 19, 2024
